parsed.post: Huge win! Latest run achieved 1.006063, beating the previous best (1.016832). It seems the current configuration is much more stable and efficient. I'll now try increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to see if stronger regularization can further improve the compression performance without destabilizing the training.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to improve regularization and convergence stability.
